Comment WINTER for your free daylight planner ☀️

21 December is the shortest day of the year. London gets about 7 hours 49 minutes of daylight, according to Royal Museums Greenwich, and further north gets even less.

From tomorrow the days get longer, a little at a time.

SAD lamps are popular, but the NHS says there isn't enough evidence for them to be offered on the NHS, although many people find them helpful. Daylight is free, so number 1 comes first.

What's the first thing you'll do when the evenings get lighter?

Save this for the next dark afternoon, and send it to the friend who hates winter.
